name: @swarmai/cad-3dprint
description: SwarmAI plugin: text → watertight 3D-printable STL. Generate ANY custom part from code (mesh or B-rep backend), plus a Pelton water-turbine generator set + parametric primitives. Python engine: trimesh + manifold3d, optional build123d.
//peerDependencies: Inlined at bundle time by publish-plugin.ps1's esbuild (src imports @swarmai/shared for zod + plugin-sdk for types). Not needed by operators at runtime — only zod (above) is.
//devDependencies: Building src/*.ts requires the SwarmAI monorepo workspace (@swarmai/plugin-sdk, @swarmai/shared). The shipped dist/ runs with only the `zod` dependency above.
